title: Open Startups
summary: Matilha designed the name and visual identity for Open Startups: the platform that connects startups, corporations, professionals, investors and universities.
challenge: Open Startups needed a name and a brand that could hold the network it runs. A platform that brings together startups, large companies, executives, scientists and governments needed a presence that could speak to all of those worlds, without sounding too casual or like a scientific paper.
solution: We started with naming and built a visual identity and applications. The tagline Essential connections, a Sober Blue and Energy Blue palette, and a cut of real pieces: from Oiweek to the t-shirt.

story.approach: At Matilha, naming and branding move together. The work was to give the platform a name, a mark and pieces that hold up off the board.
